name: ECHO: Survive Your Past
subtitle: Time, memory & cosmic puzzles
promotionalText: Play ECHO for free. Your route becomes the danger. Explore memory, choice and science. Remove ads once, with no subscription. Original owners keep ad-free access.
description:
Your route becomes the danger. Your next turn is still yours.

ECHO: Survive Your Past is a science-fiction survival puzzle about memory, consequences and the freedom to change direction. Guide a bright Signal through the Keepers’ damaged network. Collect every spark, open the exit and leave enough space for the echoes that repeat your own movements.

A safe crossing can become a trap seconds later. Move with intention, watch the line behind you and try a different answer when a familiar route fails. Short attempts make room for observation, experimentation and one more thoughtful turn.

A ROAD THROUGH ELEVEN SKIES
Explore 77 handcrafted maps across 11 regions: the Lighthouse, orbital gardens, Tessera’s fractured ice, the remains of Cinder, Ashcrown’s observation stations and the Glass Nebula. Gates, beams, moving debris and field wells give each region its own rhythm. The sky belongs to the place; the hazards belong to its history.

AN ARCHIVE YOU RECOVER
The story arrives in fragments as you progress. Recover field notes, voices and records of the Keepers. Discoveries wait for the end of an attempt, so the Archive can grow without interrupting your movement. Read at your own pace, revisit a fragment and connect it to the place where you found it.

PHILOSOPHY MEETS SCIENTIFIC CURIOSITY
What can we choose when the past keeps returning? When does a useful habit become a command? How do we recognize an explanation that needs to change?

ECHO explores these questions through its fiction and through short, sourced notes: Epictetus on choice, Aristotle on judgment, Plato on appearances and Camus on renewed effort. Synchronization, feedback, information, gravitational lensing and the limits of physical models give the journey another layer. The Archive distinguishes real research, interpretation and the Keepers’ invented technology. These are invitations to think, not lessons you must finish to play.

TOOLS FOR A NEW ROUTE
Equip abilities in the Signal Lab and develop a connected tree of 24 permanent research nodes. Tune your approach to speed, timing, protection and collection. Paradox Rewind restores a recent local state while the discarded route leaves a temporary ghost. Learn from the trace you leave instead of trying to erase every consequence.

MORE WAYS TO FOLLOW THE SIGNAL
• Campaign: 77 authored maps and deeper recovery passes.
• Daily Rift: a familiar location with a fresh arrangement of sparks.
• Deep Time: a separate procedural expedition beyond the charts.
• Optional Game Center ratings and achievements.
• English and Russian, with automatic language selection and an in-game switch.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY WITH APPLE WATCH
Play the Keeper Chronometer on the watch itself: 36 compact rooms across Calibration, Regulation and Certification, with rewards for the paired iPhone campaign. Or use Apple Watch to steer a run on your iPhone. Both are optional; you can complete the main campaign without a watch. Watch play and watch-controlled sessions have no ads.

A COMPLETE GAME, WITH A QUIET AD POLICY
All existing regions, modes, research and Archive records remain available through ordinary progression. The first five campaign maps are always ad-free. Later, rare ads may appear only at suitable transitions after successful solo campaign levels. Death, Retry, Rewind, major discoveries and region finales are protected.

One non-consumable Remove Ads purchase disables all advertising, with no subscription. Owners of the original paid ECHO keep ad-free access and do not pay again. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

Core gameplay works offline. Buying and restoring may require an App Store connection. Local game progress stays on your devices; restoring a purchase does not synchronize that progress.

Look closely at what repeats. A remembered route can become a warning, a tool or a kindness left for the next traveler. The network needs new evidence. Carry it forward.

The past remains in the Archive. Carry something new home.
